Reference table of common peptide modifications

Source: R/ptm.R
ptm_reference.Rd

The lookup table behind translate_ptm(): UniMod accession, readable name and monoisotopic delta mass for the modifications seen in LC-immunopeptidomics data. Rows are ordered by how commonly the modification occurs, because delta-mass lookup takes the first row within tolerance and a few modifications are mass-degenerate (Glu->pyro-Glu / Dehydrated both -18.010565; Gln->pyro-Glu / Ammonia-loss both -17.026549). Pass a reordered or extended copy to translate_ptm() to change that preference.

Usage

ptm_reference()

Value

A data frame with columns accession (integer UniMod accession), name (readable modification name) and mono_mass (monoisotopic delta mass in Da).

See also

translate_ptm(), which consumes this table.

Examples

head(ptm_reference())
#>   accession            name  mono_mass
#> 1        35       Oxidation  15.994915
#> 2         4 Carbamidomethyl  57.021464
#> 3         1          Acetyl  42.010565
#> 4         7      Deamidated   0.984016
#> 5        21         Phospho  79.966331
#> 6        28   Gln->pyro-Glu -17.026549
subset(ptm_reference(), name == "Oxidation")
#>   accession      name mono_mass
#> 1        35 Oxidation  15.99492
